sentences.en: Even poisonous snakes will only attack if they feel threatened.
sentences.zh: 即使是毒蛇也只有在感到威胁时才会攻击。

sentences.en: A Russian chemist discovered the structure of that poisonous compound.
sentences.zh: 一位俄罗斯化学家发现了那种有毒化合物的结构。

sentences.en: Sami crushed the poisonous pills and dissolved them into juice.
sentences.zh: 萨米碾碎了毒药并将它们溶解在果汁中。

senses.zh: 有毒的 - 引起中毒的, 有害的 - 讨厌的, 恶意的
